purpose: Reduce anchoring while producing a new frontier candidate. Isolation qualifies the independence claim; final mathematical optimality never depends on a producer's self-report of blindness.

launch_precondition.required_workspace: A new empty Code workspace with no repository connection or mounted repository.
launch_precondition.fallback_if_platform_requires_repository: Use a newly created empty study-only repository containing only the blind producer input capsule. It must have no remote, submodule, inherited history, object database, cache or filesystem path connected to the baseline implementation.
fail_if_visible: any checkout, object database, branch, source, test, documentation or artifact from the baseline implementation
any earlier study-phase input or output
any previous proposed architecture, review, remediation, checker or acceptance artifact

permitted_inputs: the exact files sealed in PHASE-2-BLIND-PRODUCER-INPUT.zip
public primary sources needed for current frontier research
files created by the producer inside the fresh output workspace
forbidden_inputs: the baseline repository or any mirror, checkout, Git object, branch, source, test, documentation or issue
all prior Phase-2 outputs, reviews, checkers, negative controls and candidate architectures
the reviewer-only frozen-gates capsule or its contents
any hidden reviewer implementation beyond the public rules included in the blind capsule
prior conversations, memory, session summaries, personal-context retrieval, connected file stores or code-search connectors
any architecture answer supplied by the creator or another model
forbidden_actions: use through a subagent or connector
public_network_rule: Public research is permitted only for primary specifications, official manuals/source, official legal sources and research papers. Accessed URLs and supported claims must be recorded contemporaneously.

first_action_gate.action: Before architecture research or design, create PHASE-2-ENVIRONMENT-ATTESTATION.json and PHASE-2-ACCESS-LEDGER.jsonl from the visible empty workspace and sealed input inventory.
must_record: whether any Git repository or remote is present
whether any forbidden path or connector is mounted or available

incident_rule.effect_on_final_ceiling: Neither FAILED nor UNVERIFIED can support a blind-independence claim. Neither can establish or refute final optimality; the later universal proof gate remains decisive.

repository_rule.study_repo_writes: Only if the platform requires a new empty study-only repo; then only sealed blind inputs and fresh outputs are permitted.
repository_rule.phase_3_reveal: The baseline repository normally becomes visible only after the fresh Phase-2 producer has stopped and its submission archive hash is fixed. Any deviation changes the blindness label, not the mathematical success theorem.
